case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for setting out the cost drivers and their weights alongside your offer. We recognise that alloy, labour and processing costs have risen and warrant a calculation-led review.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

A longer agreement offers continuity of business in return for a lower fixed price grounded in your actual purchasing coverage. We are flexible on payment terms, with Option B retaining the payment term you requested; please tell us which option works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our partnership and appreciate your openness to a fact-based discussion.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your calculations regarding the cost drivers and your note on our delivery performance. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. To support a 24-month agreement, we must apply an AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this period is not feasible.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Building on your preferred 30-day payment term, we can offer a revised price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for lowering your price and offering a payment-linked alternative. We recognise that a longer agreement needs protection against genuine alloy-cost changes, with actual purchasing coverage reflected in the calculation.

We are making a modest step by accepting indexation in exchange for further price movement; all options include the clause you requested, with Option B offering adjustment without a deadband for a lower price. We are flexible on the deadband, so please let us know which option works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.27 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.22 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive approach and look forward to continuing our cooperation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
